## Devon Dampier does it all in Utah's Holy War win over BYU

* * *

By AP

Updated: Nov 7, 2026, 10:13 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

SALT LAKE CITY -- — [Devon Dampier](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5105849/devon-dampier) accounted for four touchdowns, Utah intercepted four [Bear Bachmeier](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5141367/bear-bachmeier) passes and the third-ranked Utes remained undefeated with a 28-20 victory over No. 7 BYU on Saturday.

Dampier hurt the Cougars with with his arm and legs, finishing with 266 yards of offense to help the Utes (9-0, 6-0 Big 12, No. 3 CFP) snap a three-game losing streak in the Holy War rivalry series.

## Utah outlasts TCU to remain undefeated

* * *

By AP

Updated: Nov 22, 2026, 07:07 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

FORT WORTH, Texas -- — [Devon Dampier](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5105849/devon-dampier) threw a 68-yard touchdown pass before halftime and an 85-yard clincher in the fourth quarter as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17 on Saturday night for its 17th straight victory, clinching a spot in the Big 12 championship game.

Dampier also ran for two scores to lift the Utes (11-0, 8-0 Big 12, No. 2 CFP), who blew a 17-point halftime lead.
